title: 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF: 2^40 events of the map without a halt
text: The event map of 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF, proved in Lean, has now been run for 2^40 = 1.1·10^12 events from the list 7, 2 without reaching a halting list; the tape then holds 3.2·10^12 ones in 9 blocks. Near misses keep their rate: about 20 second blocks below 100 per doubling of the run, none below 28 in the last ten doublings.
